title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain: (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS, Zero-Assumption Det-m_boot & Armored H5 (p0=0.0025, N1=196), E[W_G1] < 2^114.307168872801 G1 units

claims.statement: For BLS12-381 plain G1 ECDLP (bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain), on any supplied T = [x]P0 in G1 (uniform x in 0..r-1, including T = infinity for x = 0, with no auxiliary powers), under explicitly declared exploratory-v1 STNFS premises (H1, H2, H3, H-X, H-EA, H5 at weakened p0_floor=0.0025 over N_tree=196 slots; ZERO empirical boot-norm distribution premise via deterministic Lovasz m_boot=2592.0 and Bin-Conditioned Mediant + Wald Theorem over 318 contiguous norm bins covering [0,2592]), the self-contained (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS algorithm transfers (P0, T) to G_T via the public pairing e(., Q0) and recovers the 64-hex scalar x with [x]P0 = T with cold-run success probability >= 0.39 and expected total classical work E[W_G1] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*10*(2^112.3428 + 2^66) < 2^114.307168872801 G1 units (C = 2,000 baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A integer instructions; core rows in C_core = 20,000 = 10 G1 units, core 2^110.985240777914, unified aborting meter t_run = 2^123 core units giving deterministic pointwise cap < 2^126.3219282 G1 units).
